title: 第十二章 受害者与冤大头

content_zh:
不说别的，只是辱骂孟师叔这一条，若是反馈上去，那就是一条大罪，更不要说居然还想拔剑杀死自己的同门师弟，而且还付诸了行动……
楚阳心有余悸的抹了一把冷汗：“幸亏他自己摔倒了……要不然……乌师姐，要不然我就……”
他说到这里，不再说下去，可怜兮兮的看着乌倩倩。不过，“他自己摔倒了……”这句话，他也真好意思说……
“要不然你就被他杀了。”可怜的小姑娘很轻易的就上套了，顺嘴就替楚阳接上了这句“没有说完的话”。
“对啊！”楚阳猛的一拍手，发出“啪”的一声，很是英雄所见略同的欣慰道：“还是乌师姐明见万里，洞彻是非，公平公正，慧眼如炬啊……”
乌倩倩隐隐觉得有哪里不对，但却又觉得对方的话也没错，懵懵懂懂的点了点头，再加上一连串的夸奖，毕竟是少女心性，居然觉得有些飘飘然起来……
便在这时，李剑吟终于从深深地土坑之中抬起了头，他受了伤，却没晕；耳朵听得清清楚楚，听到楚阳三言两语居然就变成了受害者，险些气得直接狂喷一口鲜血而亡。
但喉咙里还堵着好大一块泥土，想吐血也吐不出来。忍住剧痛，用手指挖了挖口中泥土，至于喉咙里的实在吐不出来，他也是憋气憋得很了，居然狠了狠心猛的一伸脖子，使劲咽了下去……
这却是没办法的事，再不弄走那块土，李剑吟就活生生憋死了。
楚阳和乌倩倩眼睁睁的看着李剑吟脖子越伸越长，脖子中间，就像是一条不大的蛇吞了一个完整的鸡蛋那样，好大的一圈突起顺着脖颈慢慢地往下落，终于咕嘟一声消失，脖子恢复原状……
两人不由均是瞪直了眼睛，咽了一口唾沫……
这……这真恐怖……
“噗——”李剑吟终于一口血痰吐了出来，拉风箱一般呼呼喘气，窒息的难受居然让他暂时忽略了断掉的腿，额，也算是因祸得福……
不过，这毕竟是不长久，立即，腿上的剧痛脸上的剧痛……肚子里连沙带石带泥土咽下去好大一块，拉的肠胃也在火辣辣的痛……
这一刻，李剑吟恨不得自己干脆的死了算了……
切切实实的领略到了，什么叫做真正的‘痛不欲生’。
想要骂人，却一时还喘不过气。
过了一会，李剑吟终于抬起头，狰狞的看着楚阳：“楚阳！你等着，我不会放过你的！今生今世，我与你不死不休！哎呀……”一边说一边浑身颤抖，本想在心上人面前表达一下自己的硬气，却实在忍不住……
楚阳一哆嗦：“乌师姐，你看看你看看……”
乌倩倩安慰道：“楚师弟放心，这件事我全程目睹，怎么会让人为难与你？李师弟也是一时气话，你不必介怀……”

地上的李剑吟“嗬嗬”两声怪响从喉咙里发出来，翻着白眼不可置信的看着乌倩倩，终于崩溃了：全程目睹？您全程目睹啥了？我都快被人玩死了啊啊啊……
就在这时，乌倩倩终于发现了不对劲，一声惊呼：“李师弟……你的腿？！”接着又震惊起来：“你的鼻子……”
李剑吟泪流满面，以头抢地，砰砰有声。亲娘！您终于发现了，可怜我身受重伤可能残疾……心情激动之下，居然“呜呜”的哭了起来……
天外楼的后起之秀，第二号人物的儿子，居然当众嚎哭……这件事，让刚要过去的乌倩倩脑筋有些短路，眨了眨俏丽的眼睛，实在不明白咋回事：真的很痛么？至于这样子么？咱们可是流血不流泪的江湖人……
她却不知道李剑吟实在是因为郁闷冤屈又加上实在是疼痛难忍……其实最大的郁闷，是来自乌倩倩……
便在这时，紫竹林中一阵簌簌作响，两个人快速的奔了过来：“什么人在此喧哗？嗯？楚阳？发生了什么事？”
却是石千山和谈昙到来了。
两人一见门前这乱糟糟的场面，均是目瞪口呆。
“大师兄，你可要为我做主！”楚阳悲愤的叫道，现成的挡箭牌如何不用？这可是祸水东流的最好机会。狗咬狗的戏，大家都喜欢看的：“刚才我险些就被人杀了……就在咱们门口，这家伙一来就骂师傅，然后又骂我们是废物……”
石千山的脸色顿时沉了下来。
石千山虽然心机深沉，但这事却无法置身事外。若是有人辱骂师父自己还无动于衷，那么，自己在师门中还咋混？更何况石千山平生自负，自认为无论心机手段和努力程度，在年轻一辈均是无人能及，一向以门派大师兄为自己奋斗目标，如今被人骂废物？

content_en:
Not to mention anything else, just insulting Master Meng, if it was reported back, it would be a serious crime, not to mention that he actually wanted to draw a sword and kill his fellow junior brother, and also took action...
Chu Yang wiped cold sweat with lingering fear: "Fortunately, he fell down...otherwise...Senior Sister Wu, or I would..."
At this point, he stopped talking and looked at Wu Qianqian pitifully. However, he was really embarrassed to say "He fell down..."
"Otherwise you will be killed by him." The poor little girl fell into the trap easily and finished Chu Yang's "unfinished words" smoothly.
"That's right!" Chu Yang clapped his hands fiercely and made a "pop" sound. He was very pleased that the hero saw the same thing and said, "Senior Sister Wu still sees thousands of miles, knows right and wrong, is fair and impartial, and has a sharp eye..."
Wu Qianqian vaguely felt that something was wrong, but she also felt that what the other party said was correct. She nodded in confusion, and added a series of compliments. After all, she was a girl's character, and she actually felt a little elated...
At this moment, Li Jianyin finally raised his head from the deep pit. He was injured, but not fainted; he could hear clearly, and after hearing Chu Yang's few words, he actually became a victim. He was so angry that he almost spit out a mouthful of blood and died.
But there was still a big piece of dirt stuck in my throat, and I couldn't vomit blood even if I wanted to. Holding back the severe pain, he dug out the dirt in his mouth with his fingers. As for the stuff in his throat that he couldn't spit out, he was holding his breath too hard, so he stretched out his neck and swallowed hard...
There was nothing that could be done about it. If the piece of soil was not taken away, Li Jianyin would suffocate to death.
Chu Yang and Wu Qianqian watched helplessly as Li Jianyin's neck stretched longer and longer. In the middle of the neck, it was like a small snake swallowing a whole egg. A large circle of protrusions slowly dropped down the neck, and finally disappeared with a grunt, and the neck returned to its original shape...
The two of them couldn't help but stared and swallowed...
This...this is really scary...
"Pfft--" Li Jianyin finally spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm, gasping for breath like a bellows. The discomfort of suffocation actually made him temporarily ignore his broken leg. Well, it was a blessing in disguise...
However, this did not last long after all. Immediately, I felt severe pain in my legs, severe pain in my face... I swallowed a huge piece of sand, stones and dirt in my stomach, and my stomach was also in burning pain...
At this moment, Li Jianyin wished he could just die...
I truly understand what it means to be truly ‘unbearable to live’.
I wanted to curse, but I couldn't breathe for a while.
After a while, Li Jianyin finally raised his head and looked at Chu Yang ferociously: "Chu Yang! Just wait, I won't let you go! I will fight you until death in this life! Oh..." As he spoke, he was shaking all over. He wanted to express his toughness in front of his sweetheart, but he couldn't help it...
Chu Yang trembled: "Senior Sister Wu, look, look, look..."
Wu Qianqian consoled her: "Junior brother Chu, don't worry. I witnessed the whole thing. How could anyone make it difficult for you? Junior brother Li also said something out of anger, so you don't have to worry about it..."
Li Jianyin on the ground made two strange sounds of "ho ho" from his throat, rolled his eyes and looked at Wu Qianqian in disbelief, and finally collapsed: Witnessed the whole thing? What did you witness throughout the process? I'm almost being played to death...
At this moment, Wu Qianqian finally realized something was wrong and exclaimed: "Junior Brother Li...your legs?!" Then she was shocked: "Your nose..."
Li Jianyin burst into tears and grabbed the ground with his head, making a banging sound. Mother! You finally discovered that I am seriously injured and may be disabled... I was so excited that I started crying...
The rising star of Tianwai Tower, the son of the number two man, actually cried in public... This incident made justWu Qianqian's brain was short-circuited as she was about to pass. She blinked her pretty eyes and really didn't understand what was going on: Does it really hurt? As for this? We are Jianghu people who bleed but don’t shed tears...
She didn't know that Li Jianyin was really depressed because of his injustice and the unbearable pain... In fact, the biggest depression came from Wu Qianqian...
At this moment, there was a rustling sound in the purple bamboo forest, and two people ran over quickly: "Who is making a noise here? Huh? Chu Yang? What happened?"
But it was Shi Qianshan and Tan Tan who arrived.
When the two of them saw the messy scene in front of the door, they were both stunned.
"Elder brother, you have to make the decision for me!" Chu Yang shouted angrily, why not use the ready-made shield? This is the best opportunity for disaster to flow to the east. Everyone likes to watch the dog-eat-dog scene: "I was almost killed just now...right at our door. This guy scolded the master as soon as he came, and then called us trash..."
Shi Qianshan's face suddenly darkened.
Although Shi Qianshan was deeply scheming, he could not stay out of this matter. If someone insults the master and he is indifferent, then how can he still hang out in the master's sect? What's more, Shi Qianshan was arrogant throughout his life. He believed that no matter his scheming, methods or level of hard work, he was unmatched by anyone in the younger generation. He had always regarded the sect's senior master as his goal, but now he was called a waste?
